statement: Conditional two-choice effects are measured, but neither global separability nor a need for a joint allocator is established.
reasons: Total signed interaction means and frozen-context dataset AP interactions have intervals crossing zero.
Nonzero replay exceedance is not significance or practical importance when the replay threshold is zero.
The study uses a near-full fixed-count local choice space and fixed remapped policies, not learned matched-cost policies or an evaluated practical-equivalence margin.
